patthana18.16:1.1: sāsavaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāsavo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana18.16:2.1: anāsavaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāsavo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana18.16:3.1: hetuyā cattāri. lokiyadukasadisaṃ. āsavasampayuttaduka hetuduke naāsavasampayuttaduka nahetudukaṃ
